summary: Real-time navigation and local discovery — Street View and review depth create a hard-to-replicate physical-world data moat.
moat: Google Maps' moat is its proprietary Street View imagery covering 220 countries, real-time traffic data crowdsourced from billions of Android devices, and over a billion user-contributed reviews and photos. This physical-world data layer is expensive to replicate and cannot be scraped. Navigation depends on the freshness of road conditions that requires continuous sensor input from its massive installed base.

challengers.name: ChatGPT local search with Yelp integration
challengers.evidence: OpenAI added local search with Yelp integration to ChatGPT in 2024, enabling users to get restaurant and venue recommendations directly without opening Maps.
